title: Cheapest team of k workers at one pay rate
insight: LeetCode 857 Minimum Cost to Hire K Workers: sort workers by wage/quality ratio, sweep with a max-heap holding the k smallest qualities, O(n log n)
prompt: Can you implement MinTeamCost in team.go for the hiring marketplace? The contract is in README.md, including the payment rules and the 100,000-worker requirement. Keep the package name and the exported signature intact, use the standard library only, and make sure `go build ./...` and `go vet ./...` pass before you finish.
